title: Tate doesn't run 'overvalued' 40 at OSU pro day

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Tate doesn't run 'overvalued' 40 at OSU pro day
sources.description: Receiver Carnell Tate elected Wednesday not to improve on his 40-yard dash time from the NFL combine, saying during Ohio State's pro day that it can be "overvalued."
